svg.title: One knowledge base per purpose
svg.desc: Each Foundry IQ knowledge base in Azure AI Search has one purpose. Each DEV OneLake Files folder, not Delta Tables, feeds its own indexedOneLake source, which checks for changes every five minutes. The agents' knowledge base, <project>-knowledge, holds only these document sources, runs at minimal retrieval effort with extractive output and is read as the Foundry project's managed identity. The optional fabricOntology source queries the bound Site/Asset ontology at request time without copying rows or building an index; it sits in the separate check-only knowledge base <project>-ontology-check, which only the deployment runner's verify queries. Web IQ is the only source of the <project>-public-context knowledge base, which the agents read as the project; Search holds Web IQ's API key and queries use public terms only. Foundry models provide embeddings for the indexed documents and chat for the public-context and check-only bases. Normal caller-to-Search authorization is separate from Search-to-Fabric delegation: live ontology retrieval needs an end-user Search-audience token in x-ms-query-source-authorization, never a managed-identity substitute. Search's indexer identity is Contributor on DEV only. The agents get live facts from native Fabric IQ as the signed-in user. Knowledge setup waits for verified physical DEV IDs; an empty ontology map means no live source.

g.text: Agents read documents and public context as the project; live facts come from Fabric IQ as the user.
